en.tooltip:
Previous value:
The currency-denomimated price of the goods at declaration header level with an accuracy of no more than two decimal places is entered. The price is the amount actually paid or to be paid for the goods, while taking into account all cash, quantity or other discounts that are acceptable when determining the customs value.

New value:
The currency-denominated price of the goods at declaration header level with an accuracy of no more than two decimal places is entered. The price is the amount actually paid or to be paid for the goods, while taking into account all cash, quantity or other discounts that are acceptable when determining the customs value.

en.text: Constraint NR1380 changed: "If reason code is N, target declaration type must be D" → "IF Invalidation reason = 'N' THEN Declaration …".
en.tooltip: Previous value: If reason code is N, target declaration type must be D New value: IF Invalidation reason = 'N' THEN Declaration type on the original declaration must be 'D'

en.text: Constraint NR1382 changed: "If Additional information code is FISUR then Additional Dec…" → "IF Additional information code = 'FISUR' THEN …".
en.tooltip: Previous value: If Additional information code is FISUR then Additional Declaration type must be A New value: IF Additional information code = 'FISUR' THEN Additional declaration type = 'A'

en.text: Constraint NR1384 changed: "If (additional declaration type is R or additional informat…" → "IF (Additional declaration type = 'R' OR Addition…".
Constraint NR1390 changed: "If additional declaration type is not A, B or C then additi…" → "IF Additional declaration type is in SET {A, B, C, X…".
en.tooltip: Previous value: If additional declaration type is not A, B or C then additional information FIFAL is not allowed. New value: IF Additional declaration type is in SET {A, B, C, X, Y} THEN Additional information code cannot be 'FIFAL'

en.text: Constraint NR1392 changed: "If declarant is private person, FIFAL-code is not allowed." → "IF Declarant/Nature is in SET {C, H, P} TH…".
en.tooltip: Previous value: If declarant is private person, FIFAL-code is not allowed. New value: IF Declarant/Nature is in SET {C, H, P} THEN Additional information code cannot be 'FIFAL'

en.text: Constraint NR3002 changed: "If requested procedure is different than 71, previous proc…" → "IF Requested procedure code <> '71' AND Previous …".
en.tooltip: Previous value: If requested procedure is different than 71, previous procedure is 21, and declaration is not lodged from TUTTU, then there must exist either: - additional document type C019, or - additional information code FISAP. New value: IF Requested procedure code <> '71' AND Previous procedure code = '21' THEN either Supporting document/Document type = 'C019' OR Additional information code = 'FISAP' = 'R'

en.text:
Constraint NR3003 changed: "If previous procedure is either 11 or 21
and declaration i…" → "If previous procedure is either 11 or 21
and declaration i…".
en.tooltip:
Previous value:
If previous procedure is either 11 or 21
and declaration is not lodged from TUTTU,
then there must be declared either:
- additional document type C660,
- additional document type C710, or
- additional information code FIOEI.

New value:
If previous procedure is either 11 or 21
and declaration is not lodged from TUTTU,
and declaration type is IM,
then there must be declared either:
- additional document type C660,
- additional document type C710, or
- additional information code FIOEI.

en.text: Constraint NR3008 changed: "If Additional information code is 00100, then Additional De…" → "IF Additional information code = '00100' THEN …".
en.tooltip: Previous value: If Additional information code is 00100, then Additional Declaration type must be A or D. New value: IF Additional information code = '00100' THEN Additional declaration type must be in SET {A, D}

en.text: Constraint NR3010 changed: "If additional information codes 00100 (header level) and FI…" → "IF Declaration/Additional information/Addi…".
en.tooltip: Previous value: If additional information codes 00100 (header level) and FIARE (item level) are declared, then Importer must be finnish or EU private person (C, H). New value: IF Declaration/Additional information/Additional information code = '00100' AND Goods item/Additional information/Additional information code = 'FIARE' THEN Importer/Nature must be in SET {C, H}

en.text: Constraint NR3014 changed: "If previous procedure is 51 and additional procedure code …" → "IF Previous procedure code = '51' AND Additional …".
en.tooltip: Previous value: If previous procedure is 51 and additional procedure code 160 is declared, then additional document type C601 must exist on the corresponding goods item. New value: IF Previous procedure code = '51' AND Additional procedure code = '160' THEN Supporting document/Document type = 'C601' = 'R'

en.text: Constraint NR3015 changed: "If previous procedure is 53 and additional procedure code …" → "IF Previous procedure code = '53' AND Additional …".
en.tooltip: Previous value: If previous procedure is 53 and additional procedure code 160 is declared, then additional document type C516 must exist on the corresponding goods item. New value: IF Previous procedure code = '53' AND Additional procedure code = '160' THEN Supporting document/Document type = 'C516' = 'R'

en.text: Constraint NR3016 changed: "If previous procedure is 71 and additional procedure code …" → "IF Previous procedure code = '71' AND Additional …".
en.tooltip: Previous value: If previous procedure is 71 and additional procedure code 160 is declared, then there must exist additional document of type either C517, C518 or C519 on corresponding goods item. New value: IF Previous procedure code = '71' AND Additional procedure code = '160' THEN Supporting document/Document type in SET {C517, C518, C519} = 'R'

en.text: Constraint NR3017 changed: "If requested procedure is 61, 63 or 68, previous procedure…" → "IF Previous procedure code is in SET {61, 63, 68} AN…".
en.tooltip: Previous value: If requested procedure is 61, 63 or 68, previous procedure is 21 and additional procedure code 160 is declared, then additional document type C019 must exist on the corresponding goods item. New value: IF Previous procedure code is in SET {61, 63, 68} AND Previous procedure code = '21' AND Additional procedure code = '160' THEN Supporting document/Document type = 'C019' = 'R'

en.text: Constraint NR3018 changed: "IF Requested procedure = 44 THEN one of the following …" → "IF Requested procedure code = '44' THEN Author…".
en.tooltip: Previous value: IF Requested procedure = 44 THEN one of the following must be declared: - Authorisation type EUS - Additional information code 00100 (header-level) New value: IF Requested procedure code = '44' THEN Authorisation with Authorisation type = 'EUS' OR Declaration/Additional information/Additional information code = '00100' must be declared

en.text: Constraint NR3021 changed: "If Requested procedure is 44 and additional procedure 653 e…" → "IF Requested procedure code = '44' AND Additional…".
en.tooltip: Previous value: If Requested procedure is 44 and additional procedure 653 exists, then Additional information code FIALV must be declared New value: IF Requested procedure code = '44' AND Additional procedure code = '653' THEN Additional information with Additional information code = 'FIALV' must be declared

en.text: Constraint NR3022 changed: "IF Requested Procedure = 46 THEN Authorisation type OPO mus…" → "IF Requested procedure code = '46' THEN Author…".
en.tooltip: Previous value: IF Requested Procedure = 46 THEN Authorisation type OPO must exist New value: IF Requested procedure code = '46' THEN Authorisation with Authorisation type = 'OPO' must be declared

en.text: Constraint NR3024 changed: "IF Requested procedure = 48 THEN one of the following …" → "IF Requested procedure code = '48' THEN Author…".
en.tooltip: Previous value: IF Requested procedure = 48 THEN one of the following must be declared: - Authorisation type OPO - Additional information code 00100 (header-level) New value: IF Requested procedure code = '48' THEN Authorisation with Authorisation type = 'OPO' OR Declaration/Additional information/Additional information code = '00100' must be declared

en.text: Constraint NR3026 changed: "IF Requested Procedure = 51 THEN IF Previous procedure…" → "IF Requested procedure code = '51' AND Previous p…".
en.tooltip: Previous value: IF Requested Procedure = 51 THEN IF Previous procedure = 11 THEN Authorisation type IPO must exists ELSE one of the following must be declared: - Authorisation type IPO - Additional information code 00100 (header) New value: IF Requested procedure code = '51' AND Previous procedure code = '11' THEN Authorisation type = 'IPO' or 'C601' ELSE Authorisation type = 'IPO' or 'C601' OR Additional information code = '00100'

en.text: Constraint NR3035 changed: "If Requested Procedure is 53 then Authorisation Type TEA mu…" → "IF Requested procedure code = '53' THEN Author…".
en.tooltip: Previous value: If Requested Procedure is 53 then Authorisation Type TEA must exist or Additional information code 00100 must exist. New value: IF Requested procedure code = '53' THEN Authorisation with Authorisation type = 'TEA' OR Declaration/Additional information/Additional information code = '00100' must be declared

en.text: Constraint NR3060 changed: "If Previous procedure = 11 THEN Authorization type IPO mus…" → "IF Previous procedure code = '11' THEN the IPO au…".
en.tooltip: Previous value: If Previous procedure = 11 THEN Authorization type IPO must include Prior export of products obtained from equivalent goods New value: IF Previous procedure code = '11' THEN the IPO authorisation must include prior export of products obtained from equivalent goods

en.text: Constraint NR3061 changed: "If Previous procedure is 51 there must be declared one of t…" → "If Previous procedure is 51 there must be declared one of t…".
en.tooltip:
Previous value:
If Previous procedure is 51 there must be declared one of the following previous documents for each goods item:
o type 'IM' (national previous document type) and case identification number (MRN) of inward processing declaration
o type MRN and case identification number (MRN) of inward processing declaration
o type 821 and transit MRN?? « tarkista!
or 
o Additional document type C710(detail of used  the standardized exchange of information exists

New value:
If Previous procedure is 51 there must be declared one of the following previous documents for each goods item:
o type 'IM' (national previous document type) and case identification number (MRN) of inward processing declaration
o type MRN and case identification number (MRN) of inward processing declaration
o type 821 and transit MRN?? < tarkista!
or 
o Additional document type C710(detail of used  the standardized exchange of information exists

en.text: Constraint NR3079 changed: "If Additional document type is C990 or N990 AND additional…" → "IF Supporting document/Document type is in SE…".
en.tooltip: Previous value: If Additional document type is C990 or N990 AND additional information code 00100 does not exist then authorisation type must be EUS. New value: IF Supporting document/Document type is in SET {C990, N990} AND Additional information code = '00100' is not declared THEN Authorisation type = 'EUS'

en.text: Constraint NR3082 changed: "If Authorisation type is OPO and Requested procedure is 48 …" → "IF Authorisation type = 'OPO' AND Requested proce…".
en.tooltip: Previous value: If Authorisation type is OPO and Requested procedure is 48 then authorisation must include Prior import of replacement products New value: IF Authorisation type = 'OPO' AND Requested procedure code = '48' THEN the authorisation must include prior import of replacement products

en.text: Constraint NR3118 changed: "If Requested procedure is 51 and Previous procedure is oth…" → "IF Requested procedure code = '51' AND Previous p…".
en.tooltip: Previous value: If Requested procedure is 51 and Previous procedure is other than 11 and authorisation type is IPO THEN UTU checks automatically in Authorisation register: TARIC code (6/15) in the customs declaration must match with the first 4 digits (CN-level) to one of the codes (data element 5/1) included in the authorisation. New value: IF Requested procedure code = '51' AND Previous procedure code != '11' THEN the first 4 digits of declared Commodity code - Harmonised System code must match details in authorisation

en.text: Constraint NR3119 changed: "If authorisation type is IPO, OPO, EUS or TEA THEN authoris…" → "IF Authorisation type is in SET {EUS, IPO, OPO, TEA}…".
en.tooltip: Previous value: If authorisation type is IPO, OPO, EUS or TEA THEN authorisation must be valid in authorisation register UTU checks automatically in Authorisation register: Start date of the decision (4/6) and Date of expiry of the decision (4/7) in authorisation details. IF previous procedure is 11 or 21 THEN autorisation does not need to be valid New value: IF Authorisation type is in SET {EUS, IPO, OPO, TEA} AND Previous procedure code is NOT in SET {11, 21} THEN authorisation must be valid

en.text: Constraint NR3122 changed: "If Requested procedure is 44 and Authorisation type is EUS …" → "IF Requested procedure code = '44' AND Authorizat…".
en.tooltip: Previous value: If Requested procedure is 44 and Authorisation type is EUS UTU checks automatically in Authorisation register: TARIC code (5/1) in the customs declaration must match with the 10 digits (CN-level) in the authorisation(data element 5/1) New value: IF Requested procedure code = '44' AND Authorization type = 'EUS' THEN commodity code must match details in authorisation

en.text: Constraint NR4011 changed: "If dataset type is H5P, requested procedure must be 40 and …" → "IF #H5P THEN Requested procedure code = '40' AND …".
en.tooltip: Previous value: If dataset type is H5P, requested procedure must be 40 and previous procedure must be 00. New value: IF #H5P THEN Requested procedure code = '40' AND Previous procedure code = '00'

en.text: Constraint NR4012 changed: "If dataset type is H5P and type of goods is "new goods", VA…" → "IF #H5P AND goods are new, VAT rate must be declared using …".
en.tooltip: Previous value: If dataset type is H5P and type of goods is "new goods", VAT rate must be declared as additional information code FIALK with appropriate Q... code in description New value: IF #H5P AND goods are new, VAT rate must be declared using Additional information code = 'FIALK'

en.text: Constraint NR4027 changed: "Previous document type N825 (PoUS) can only be used if decl…" → "Document type = 'N825' can only be used if Declar…".
en.tooltip: Previous value: Previous document type N825 (PoUS) can only be used if declaration type is CO. New value: Document type = 'N825' can only be used if Declaration type = 'CO'

en.text: Constraint NR4029 changed: "Previous document type N825 (PoUS) cannot be used for prelo…" → "IF Additional declaration type = 'D' THEN Docu…".
en.tooltip: Previous value: Previous document type N825 (PoUS) cannot be used for prelodged declaration (additional declaration type D). New value: IF Additional declaration type = 'D' THEN Document type cannot be 'N825'

en.text: Constraint R0285 changed: "When a detail is common to all goods items, it must be decl…" → "When a detail is common to all goods items, it must be decl…".
en.tooltip:
Previous value:
When a detail is common to all goods items, it must be declared at declaration header level. The details are declared at goods item level only if they differ from each other.

New value:
When a detail is common to all goods items, it must be declared at declaration level. The details are declared at goods item level only if they differ from each other.

en.text: Constraint R0671 changed: "This information is to be provided where the buyer is diffe…" → "This information is to be provided where the buyer is diffe…".
en.tooltip:
Previous value:
This information is to be provided where the buyer is different to the person provided in D.E. 3/15 Importer

New value:
This information is to be provided where the buyer is different to the person provided as importer

en.text: Constraint R0672 changed: "This information is to be provided where the seller is diff…" → "This information is to be provided where the seller is diff…".
en.tooltip:
Previous value:
This information is to be provided where the seller is different to the person provided in D.E. 3/1 Exporter

New value:
This information is to be provided where the seller is different to the person provided as exporter

Vakuus-tietoryhmän tietoja on ilmoitettava, jos  ilmoituksen perusteella tulee kannettavaksi veroja, tulleja tai muita maksuja. Ange identifieringsnumret för det lager till vilket varorna hänförts med tulldeklarationen för tullagring, t.ex. i formen FI1234567-800101. Om du som tillståndshavare har under tullagerförfarandet befordrat varor mellan olika i samma tillstånd angivna lager, ska du även i detta fall ange identifieringsnumret för det lager som angetts i tulldeklarationen när varorna hänförts till tullagerförfarandet.

Nytt värde:
Om en tulldeklaration för tullagring avslutas, ange identifieringsnumret för det lager som angetts i tulldeklarationen för tullagring, t.ex. i formen "FI1234567-800101". Om tillståndshavaren under tullagerförfarandet har befordrat varor mellan olika i samma tillstånd angivna lager, ange även i detta fall identifieringsnumret för det lager som angetts i tulldeklarationen när varorna hänförts till tullagerförfarandet.

fi.tooltip: Aiempi arvo: Ilmoitetaan koko ilmoitukselle yhteisiä lisätietojen koodeja. Esimerkiksi; Ilmoitetaan verkkolaskuosoite lisätietokoodilla FIVER, jos jaksoerittely halutaan verkkolaskuna. Ilmoitetaan lisätietokoodilla FIPER, jos kyseessä on koontijakso (pituus kuukausi M tai viikko W). Tullivarastoinnissa ilmoitetaan lisätietokoodi FICWM, jota käytetään siirrettäessä tavaraa saapumispaikalta tullivarastoon. Lisätietokoodille FIXBG pitää ilmoittaa lisätiedon kuvaukseksi lainsäädännön mukainen taloudellisen edellytyksen numeerinen koodi. …" → "Tulli lähettää asiakkaalle rekisteröintisanoman (FI426B).
T…".
fi.tooltip:
Aiempi arvo:
Tulli lähettää asiakkaalle rekisteröintisanoman (FI426B).

Tällä sanomalla asiakkaalle ilmoitetaan päättämistiedonannon rekisteröintipäivä sekä sen saama MRN-numero. Rekisteröintisanoman lähettämisen jälkeen tullivarastoinnin tulli-ilmoituksen tai esittämistiedonannon tila on asiakaskäyttöliittymällä tilassa päätetty.

Uusi arvo:

fi.text: Vaiheen 1 teksti muuttunut käyttötapauksessa "Päättämistiedonannon antaminen – virhe": "Tullivaraston luvanhaltija tai tämän edustaja lähettää Tull…" → "Tullivaraston luvanhaltija tai tämän edustaja lähettää Tull…".
fi.tooltip:
Aiempi arvo:
Tullivaraston luvanhaltija tai tämän edustaja lähettää Tullille päättämistiedonannon (FI488B).

Tullin järjestelmä tarkastaa päättämistiedonannolta asiakkaan tunnistetiedot ja ilmoituksen tietosisällön määrämuotoisuuden sekä sisällöllisen oikeellisuuden. Lisäksi Tulli tarkistaa, että seuraavaa tullimenettelyä koskeva ilmoitus on annettu.

Sanoma on muodollisesti virheetön mutta seuraavaan tullimenettelyyn liittyvän tarkastuksen yhteydessä havaittiin virhe.

Uusi arvo:

Sanoma on muodollisesti virheetön mutta seuraavaan tullimenettelyyn liittyvän tarkastuksen yhteydessä havaittiin virhe.
